def problem_spec
-- function signature
(implementation: List Int → Int)
-- inputs
(lst: List Int) :=
-- spec
let spec (result : Int) :=
  lst.length = 0 → result = 0 ∧
  lst.length > 0 →
    if lst.length > 1 then
      result = (if Even lst[1]! then lst[1]! else 0) + implementation (lst.drop 2)
